chunks: And my father (may Allah have mercy on him) and a group of my scholars narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar and Ahmad ibn Idris, all from al-Amriki, from someone who narrated to him, from Hammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked [I asked Abu Abdillah] about the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), so he said: 'In it is the reward of a Hajj and an Umrah.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) elevates the visitation of Imam al-Husayn’s shrine to the status of a complete Hajj and Umrah, emphasizing its role as a spiritual pilgrimage that fulfills the obligations of both major and minor pilgrimages. This equivalence underscores the unique ontological status of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia theology, where their graves serve as focal points for divine grace (barakah) and intercession, effectively transforming a local visit into a universal act of worship.
